title: What Good Poussette Tastes Like
author: Mattie Rynkiewicz
problems: Row 7 "larks roll away partners" can't start from where the dancers are: A roll away needs the two side by side on one side.
Row 8 "half poussette - robins pull partners back then right" can't start from where the dancers are: Going right after backing up would take the pair out of the minor set.
Row 9 "half poussette - larks pull partners back then left" can't start from where the dancers are: Going left after backing up would take the pair out of the minor set.
The progression after row 9 "half poussette - larks pull partners back then left" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.
A gyre goes by the right shoulder, facing each other, with no hands.
